orphan_works: Yes: arts. 12c-12e (added 2016, implementing Dir. 2012/28/EU) allow use of orphan works after diligent search; use ends if rightholder reappears
digital_protection: Arts. 50a-50d (added by Act 9/2006): ban on circumventing effective TPMs and trafficking devices (50b); protection of electronic rights-management info
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list: private copying, quotation (art. 14), libraries/archives/education (art. 12)
enforcement_body: Icelandic ministry responsible for culture (formerly Ministry of Education, Science and Culture)
